info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bank Draft Management API
info.description: The Bank Draft Management API allows financial institutions to efficiently manage bank drafts for consumer services. This API supports operations for creating and processing draft transactions, enabling clients to facilitate smooth payment procedures. Typical consumers include banking applications and financial service providers that require seamless integration with draft handling. By using this API, businesses can enhance their payment offerings while ensuring compliance and security in transaction processing.
